description.value: Big Way Hot Pot is a growing BC-based hot pot chain offering a self-serve individual-pot format with over 100 fresh ingredients and more than 18 broth and dry-mix options, including a signature Mala broth and vegan-friendly choices. The Robson Street location sits in Vancouver's West End, a dense, bikeable neighbourhood popular with visitors. The brand has expanded rapidly across BC and into Ontario and the US.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms Big Way Hot Pot is an active multi-location hot pot chain with a Robson (Vancouver) location listed under BC locations, and explicitly offers vegan broth options (Tomato Broth). No bike parking, water refill, washroom, or Wi-Fi information appears in either the OSM tags or website content. The website contact page shows a corporate Richmond address and generic emails rather than Robson-specific details, so the OSM phone number cannot be corroborated; notably the site also contains unfilled template placeholder text (lorem ipsum, 'contact@sushi.com') in one section, suggesting partial website incompleteness.

A site visit or direct inquiry would be needed to assess basic cyclist-friendliness before including.
